$comment: Which first-party plugins that do NOT load from the browser bundle are shipped inside the desktop installer. Frontend plugins are curated separately, by the browser builtin registry (see plugins/builtin-registry-coverage.test.ts). Everything else needs a directory on disk before the Tauri host can run it, so a plugin that is neither staged into the installer nor marked dev-only simply does not exist for a user who installed the app rather than cloning the repo. Keyed by directory name; both scripts/build/stage-bundled-plugins.mjs and the coverage guard read this file.

repowiki.reason: ADR-0146 product subsystem: repository wiki generation, dependency graph, cited search. Its 326-case pytest suite ships as source in the repo, not in the installer.

cognia-laya-guard.reason: ADR-0194 decision provider: Settings → Conversation → Decision provider lists "Laya (local)", and the inbound IM moderation hook ships with it. Seeded but manual-enable only, because activation provisions a Python venv and downloads the laya checkpoint. Calibration tools and the pytest suite stay in the repo.

devOnly.cognia-python-demo: Author reference: the smallest possible Python plugin. Copy-paste template, not a default.
devOnly.cognia-python-runtime-demo: Author reference for the Python reverse-RPC surface (ADR-0145). Exercises the contract rather than doing user-facing work.
devOnly.wasm-example-formatter: Author reference for the WASM component ABI. Its artifact is built by `cargo component` on demand and is not checked in, so there is nothing stable to stage.
